candidate.rationale: The trait ExecSpecEq already specifies ensures res == (this.deep_view() =~~= other.deep_view()). Adding an identical postcondition at the impl is redundant and triggered verifier/harness errors (e.g., 'res' not in scope) and a private-module import issue. Leave the behavior to the trait-level spec rather than duplicating it in the impl.
risks: Adding the same ensures at the impl is redundant and may produce verifier/harness errors (as observed).
Duplicating the trait contract at the impl risks future divergence if one is updated and the other is not.
